file: Rubric - Domain-Specific Data Infrastructure for AI.htm

page-structure.evidence: Three issues: (1) Footer h4 elements ('Our Team', 'Company', 'Work With Us') follow h2 directly — level skip h2→h4, confirmed by axe heading-order on h4[data-testid='text-team-title']. (2) Duplicate h3/h2 headings exist in DOM (zero-size, not aria-hidden): e.g. 'Expert Signal Elicitation' appears twice — second copy has offsetWidth=0/offsetHeight=0 but aria=null, so AT still reads it as a heading. (3) No <nav> landmark — navCount:0 despite a 7-link header nav cluster; hasNav:false in structure. Title 'Rubric - Domain-Specific Data Infrastructure for AI' is descriptive (passes 2.4.2). 'OUR RESEARCH PILLARS' div (el21) is a visually-styled eyebrow label with no heading role — consistent with page pattern. Missing <h1>... H1 is present ('Rubric AI is a reasoning and verification layer.'). Best-practice note: headings are semantically used to organize content (2.4.10 AAA satisfied in structure).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: Two footer <ul> lists have listStyleType:'none' and no explicit role='list' (listStyleNone:2 from collect.json). In Safari/VoiceOver these lists lose their list semantics. SR walk order matches visual DOM order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom) — no reading-order mismatch found. No open modals to check background hiding.

name-role-state.evidence: Pattern: <a> wraps a <button> — both are focusable and both appear as separate tab stops in tabWalk (stops 7 and 8). The <a> (axRole=link, axName='Talk to Us') and the inner <button> (axRole=button, axName='Talk to Us') create duplicate tab stops for a single visual control. This is invalid HTML (interactive element nested inside interactive element) and violates 4.1.2 (role/value exposed twice). axe 'nested-interactive' would flag this. Both the link and button roles are announced separately — keyboard users hit the same control twice.

focus-management.evidence: The <a> and its child <button> both receive separate keyboard focus (tabWalk stops 7 and 8). name-role-state.evidence: axRole=image, axName=null, inTree:true. The SVG is exposed as an unnamed image in the AX tree. However, the SVG is a decorative arrow icon inside a button that already has a text label 'Talk to Us'. It has no aria-hidden, no role='presentation', and no <title>. While the button's text provides the accessible name for the control, the orphaned unnamed image role in the AX tree is a 1.1.1 concern. It should have aria-hidden='true' to suppress it from the tree. The parent button's name suffices for the control, but the SVG itself fails as an exposed image with no name.

issues.evidence: Footer h4 elements skip from h2 (heading-order). Duplicate hidden h3 headings in DOM (zero-size, not aria-hidden) pollute AX heading tree. No <nav> landmark despite 7-link header navigation cluster.
Two footer <ul> lists have listStyleType:'none' with no role='list' — VoiceOver strips list semantics in Safari.

<button> nested inside <a> — both receive separate keyboard focus (tabWalk stops 7 and 8). Same pattern occurs at hero and section CTA buttons (4 occurrences total). Invalid HTML; keyboard users Tab through the same visual control twice.
Button-in-link nested-interactive pattern produces doubled tab stops for header, hero, and section CTAs — Tab order visits the same control twice consecutively (link + button). 4 CTA pairs affected.

Hero 'Talk to Us' link (el9) and its child button (el10) receive keyboard focus while off-screen in the noscript render (appearanceOffScreen:true, inViewport:false at y=558). Focus lands where user cannot see it — 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum), new WCAG 2.2 AA.

White text (rgb(255,255,255)) on orange background (rgb(250,137,56)): contrast ratio 2.41:1. Required: 4.5:1 for 14px/500-weight text. Confirmed by axe 'color-contrast' and --contrast calculation. Same orange/white palette applies to header 'Talk to Us' button (axe also flagged 'button[data-testid=button-hero-contact]' and '.min-h-8').

Orange CTA button has computedOutline='none' and no box-shadow. focus-visible:outline-none is explicit in the button class (Tailwind utility removes the browser default outline). The focus-visible:ring-1 class provides a ring via Tailwind's CSS variable, but the button is off-screen in the noscript snapshot so no focusShot exists to confirm the ring fires. Given outline:none is explicit and no shadow backup, this is flagged as REPRODUCED pending a live-scripted verification.
Decorative arrow SVG inside button exposed as axRole=image with axName=null. No aria-hidden. Should be aria-hidden='true'. Same pattern likely for other CTA button SVGs.
10x10px decorative bullet dot SVG exposed as axRole=image with axName=null. No aria-hidden. Should be aria-hidden='true'.
'OUR RESEARCH PILLARS' visually-styled section label rendered as a generic <div> (axRole=generic) with no heading role. Inaccessible to AT heading navigation.
